tileSize.note: Flare HD: engine/tileset_config.txt tile_size=192,96 (NOT 64x32). Scale factor 1/3 gives classic 64x32.

anchor: offset (ox,oy) is the pixel of the sprite that lands on the CENTER of the ground diamond of its cell. screen(cell) = ((x-y)*96, (x+y)*48 + 48) relative to the top vertex of cell (0,0); draw sprite at screen - (ox,oy).

collisionCodes.3: BLOCKS_ALL_HIDDEN (void outside map; hidden in minimap)

orientationConvention.axes: +x = screen down-right, +y = screen down-left, -x = up-left, -y = up-right. Camera looks from +x+y (south). Cell (minX-1,minY-1) is the top of a room on screen.
orientationConvention.wall_y_front: wall cell whose walkable floor is at +x (west wall of a room, runs along y). Textured face visible. Tall.
orientationConvention.wall_x_front: wall cell whose walkable floor is at +y (north wall of a room, runs along x). Textured face visible. Tall.
orientationConvention.wall_y_back: wall cell whose floor is at -x (east wall; camera sees its back/top). Dungeon: use the SHORT variant (82) so it does not hide the room.
orientationConvention.wall_x_back: wall cell whose floor is at -y (south wall). Dungeon: SHORT variant (83).
orientationConvention.corner_inner: concave room corner, only a diagonal neighbour is floor. Named by that diagonal: top=+x+y, left=+x-y, right=-x+y, bottom=-x-y.
orientationConvention.corner_outer: convex corner / wall end: two orthogonal neighbours are floor, e.g. "+x,+y".
orientationConvention.edges: floor edge tiles: side(s) where the neighbour is void.

structure: Ruins maps have NO short walls: every non-room cell is filled with void_top (153-160, collision 3) at wall height, and back walls (138/139) are top-only pieces with a black body. Result: rooms look carved into a solid masonry mass.
procgen: maps/procgen_rules/iron_labyrinth*.txt: Flare procgen stitches hand-made 28x28 chunks (procgen_type=start|end|door_north_south|door_west_east|room|links|key|treasure|vendor) with doors_max=2, door_spacing_min=2, main_path_length 10..20, branch_length 5..10, branches_per_door_level_max=2. It does NOT generate walls tile-by-tile.
